title: Distribution Transformers
scope: Requirements for oil immersed three phase distribution transformers supplying low voltage electricity from medium voltage networks, including insulation and temperature rise tests.

title: Portland Cement
scope: Requirements for Portland cement used as a binder in concrete construction, including compressive strength, setting time and soundness.

title: LED Road Luminaires
scope: Performance and electrical safety requirements for outdoor LED street lighting fixtures used to illuminate roads and public areas.

title: Industrial Protective Helmets
scope: Protective headgear for industrial and construction workers, including resistance to impact from falling objects and penetration.

title: Insulated Power Cables
scope: Requirements for insulated copper and aluminium conductors for electrical power distribution, including insulation resistance and voltage testing.

title: Steel Reinforcing Bars
scope: Requirements for steel reinforcement bars used in concrete structures, including tensile strength, ductility and bend testing.

title: Drinking Water Quality
scope: Quality parameters and sampling requirements for water intended for human consumption, including chemical and microbiological testing.

title: Centrifugal Water Pumps
scope: Performance requirements for centrifugal pumps used to transfer water, including flow rate, head and efficiency testing.

title: Portable Fire Extinguishers
scope: Requirements for portable firefighting appliances, including extinguishing performance, pressure resistance and discharge operation.

title: PVC Water Supply Pipes
scope: Requirements for rigid plastic pipes used in pressurized water supply systems, including dimensions and hydrostatic pressure resistance.
